claim: The weekday is assigned determiner function in Sunday morning.
evidence_summary: Plural Sunday mornings establishes the head. Constructed three Sunday mornings admits an internal modifier reading.
finding: Identify a test for the weekday’s function in bare on Sunday morning. Locating the head settles only half the analysis.
inference: Does identifying morning as head also identify the function of Sunday?

evidence.passage: §4, p. 357. The weekday is assigned determiner function in Sunday morning.
evidence.example: Adding plural -s to morning locates the head. In three Sunday mornings, three counts mornings and Sunday occurs within the material it quantifies. Compare the bare temporal use on Sunday morning.
evidence.establishes: There is evidence for a modifier use in the counted phrase. An independent test is needed to assign the weekday the determiner function in the bare phrase.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
